Best Session Replay Tools 2026: 10 Platforms Ranked & Compared
The best session replay tools for 2026. Compare Hotjar, FullStory, PostHog, LogRocket, Smartlook, Mouseflow, Heap, Contentsquare, Glassbox, and Crazy Egg.
July 15, 2026 Written by Joe Wilkinson
Session replay is one of the fastest ways to find conversion leaks. Quantitative analytics tells you where users drop off. Replay shows you why. The right tool can turn a hunch about a confusing form or broken flow into a five-minute fix.
This guide ranks and compares the best session replay tools for 2026. We evaluated each platform on recording quality, analytics depth, pricing, integrations, and best-fit use cases.
For a focused comparison of the top three, see Hotjar vs FullStory vs PostHog . For broader CRO tooling, see our best CRO tools roundup .

1. PostHog: Best All-in-One Value
PostHog tops the list because it is not just a session replay tool. It is a full product and growth platform that includes replay, product analytics, feature flags, A/B testing, surveys, and a data warehouse.
Why it wins:
Generous free tier: 5,000 recordings per month
Replay tied directly to product analytics funnels
Built-in experimentation so you can watch recordings by test variant
Usage-based pricing scales with your product
Best for: Product-led SaaS, engineering teams, startups that want one platform.
2. Hotjar: Best for UX Research
Hotjar remains the easiest session replay tool for non-technical teams. It is built around three core jobs: see where users click, watch what they do, and ask them why.
Why it stands out:
Fastest time-to-value for heatmaps and recordings
Excellent survey and feedback widget builder
Intuitive interface for marketers and UX researchers
Best for: Marketing teams, UX researchers, ecommerce sites.
3. FullStory: Best for Digital Experience Analytics
FullStory goes deeper than basic replay. It structures session data so you can search, segment, and quantify friction across the user journey.
Rage click, error click, and dead click detection
Advanced journey mapping and conversion analytics
Enterprise-grade security and compliance
Best for: Enterprise SaaS, financial services, healthcare, large ecommerce.
4. LogRocket: Best for Frontend Monitoring
LogRocket combines session replay with frontend performance monitoring and error tracking. When a user hits a bug, you can watch exactly what happened leading up to it.
Errors linked directly to replay
Network and console logs in session context
Product analytics for SaaS funnels
Best for: Engineering teams, SaaS products with complex frontends.
5. Smartlook: Best for Mobile Replay
Smartlook is one of the strongest tools for mobile app session replay. It supports iOS, Android, React Native, Flutter, and Unity.
Strong cross-platform support
Event-based filtering and funnels
Heatmaps for mobile apps
Best for: Mobile-first products, apps with complex touch interactions.
6. Mouseflow: Best Budget Option
Mouseflow packs heatmaps, session replay, form analytics, and funnel tools into an affordable package.
Form analytics show exactly where users abandon
Funnel visualization with replay drop-offs
Lower starting price than most competitors
Best for: Small businesses, budget-conscious CRO teams.
7. Heap: Best for Autocapture + Replay
Heap is known for autocapture analytics, which lets you define events retroactively. Its replay feature lets you watch sessions behind any event or funnel.
No manual event instrumentation required
Retroactive analysis
Replay tied to behavioral data
Best for: Teams that want analytics without heavy engineering setup.
8. Contentsquare: Best for Enterprise Ecommerce
Contentsquare is built for large ecommerce and retail organizations. It goes beyond replay with zone-based analytics, AI-powered insights, and customer journey visualization.
AI-driven opportunity detection
Strong ecommerce and merchandising analytics
Enterprise-grade scale and support
Best for: Large ecommerce, retail, enterprise digital teams.
9. Glassbox: Best for Regulated Industries
Glassbox focuses on digital experience analytics for industries with strict compliance requirements, such as banking, insurance, and healthcare.
Strong security and compliance features
Struggle and error detection
Session replay for customer support disputes
Best for: Financial services, insurance, healthcare, regulated enterprises.
10. Crazy Egg: Best for Simple Small Business Testing
Crazy Egg offers heatmaps, recordings, and basic A/B testing at a low price. It is less sophisticated than the others but easy to adopt.
Simple setup and snapshot reports
Affordable entry point
Basic A/B testing included
Best for: Small businesses, landing page optimization, simple websites.

How to Choose the Right Session Replay Tool
Use this decision tree:
Do you need product analytics too?
Yes → PostHog, LogRocket, Heap, or FullStory
No → Hotjar, Mouseflow, or Crazy Egg
Is mobile replay important?
Yes → Smartlook or LogRocket
No → Any of the top options
What is your budget?
Under $50/month → Mouseflow or Crazy Egg
$50–$200/month → Hotjar, Smartlook, LogRocket, or PostHog
$300+/month → FullStory or enterprise tools
Do you work in a regulated industry?
Yes → Glassbox or FullStory Enterprise
No → PostHog, Hotjar, or LogRocket
For most SaaS teams in 2026, PostHog is the best session replay tool because it replaces multiple tools at a lower total cost. Hotjar remains the easiest entry point for qualitative research. FullStory is the premium choice for enterprise experience analytics.
If your primary need is mobile replay, choose Smartlook . If you need replay tied to frontend errors, choose LogRocket . If you are budget-constrained, Mouseflow and Crazy Egg deliver solid value.
Start with the tool that matches your team's workflow. Session replay only creates value when people actually watch the recordings and act on what they see.
